rules: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text
Use data-testid for all interactive elements
Touch targets must be at least 44x44px
Focus states must be clearly visible (ring-2 ring-primary)

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Manrope' for all headings and 'Inter' for body text.
Implement a 'Medical Chart' aesthetic for cards: clean white backgrounds with subtle borders and soft shadows.
The 'Report for Duty' button should be massive and prominent on mobile, potentially taking up a significant portion of the screen or being a floating action button.
Use the color palette strictly: Primary Teal for main actions, Slate for neutrals, Red/Green for status.
Ensure the map view uses a clean, desaturated style if possible to maintain the professional look.
For the offline indicator, use a subtle but clear status bar at the top of the app.
Do NOT use gradients for text. Keep text solid and high-contrast.
universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for overlays.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
